review.notes: The print shop: a narrow two-storey cream house under an indigo roof with upturned corners, one big brass cogwheel on its gable, two green windows, a hand press at the door and cream sheets on a line. 62 x 61 px, no key red. Passed over: 2, 4, 8, 10, 13 no cogwheel; 7 a spinning wheel, no cog on the house; 14 a small tower; 5, 11 a porch that hides the house; 1, 3, 6, 9 a small cog; 12, 15 good too, the cog smaller or on the side wall.

chibi-cult-forge.subject: IMPROVEMENT:CULT:FORGE
chibi-cult-forge.notes: The bell foundry: a cream smithy on a stone footing under an indigo roof, a stone chimney with a puff of pale green smoke, an amber fire glow in the open arch, a dark anvil in front and a brass bell in a wooden frame. 59 x 61 px, no key red, no red. The roof has no bent point (only 2 and 5 curl, and 2 is small with no anvil glow, 5 has no glow and no smoke). Passed over: 2 small; 1, 3, 5, 6, 7, 9, 10, 12, 13, 15 no fire glow; 4, 11 no smoke; 8, 14 a low arch hall, less a house of the set.

chibi-cult-lumber-camp.subject: IMPROVEMENT:CULT:LUMBER_CAMP
chibi-cult-lumber-camp.notes: Two crooked dark-barked willows with drooping dull blue-green canopies, a green lantern hanging from one, a stack of logs, an axe in a stump and an indigo canvas lean-to. 60 x 61 px, no key red. The sixteen are near twins; 0 is the cleanest (no loose chips or extra crates: 2, 5, 6, 7, 9, 10, 11, 12, 13, 14, 15 scatter small bits round the stump).

chibi-cult-market.subject: IMPROVEMENT:CULT:MARKET
chibi-cult-market.notes: One long open stall under an awning of wide indigo and cream stripes, a brass candlestick, glass jars glowing green, a barrel in front and one teal tentacle tip curling up behind the counter; no walls, no house. 61 x 59 px, green 3.1%, no key red. One stall, not two: the two-stall candidates carry one accent each (5 brass candlesticks and no green, 13 green jars and no brass) and their goods are small. Passed over: 1 seen from the front; 2, 3, 6, 10, 11, 14 the tentacle is as big as the stall or the goods are lost; 7, 12, 15 a tentacle round the posts; 0, 4, 9 good, less green.

chibi-cult-port.subject: IMPROVEMENT:CULT:PORT
chibi-cult-port.notes: A pier of pale planks on dark posts, a cream harbour hut whose indigo roof ends in a curled hood tip, a round green window, a brass bollard, a coil of rope and a tall post with a green lantern; no boat, nothing under it. 62 x 62 px, no key red. Passed over: 12 the same hut with no bollard and a narrower pier; every other candidate has a plain gable or a cone roof with no bent point; 4, 9 are low L-shaped decks.

chibi-cult-sawmill.subject: IMPROVEMENT:CULT:SAWMILL
chibi-cult-sawmill.notes: Sample. A cream weatherboard shed under an indigo roof whose ridge curls over like a hood tip, a round green window, the round steel blade in a bench at its front and the grinning wooden idol at its side; no log (candidates with a log lost the blade: 3, 10, 11). 61 x 61 px, no key red. Passed over: 2 small; 1, 4, 7, 8, 11 a plain gable with no bent point; 5, 9 two points or a horned roof; 3, 10 no blade; 0, 6, 12, 13, 14 good too, the curl smaller or the idol hidden behind the wall.
